issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.1.0-pre ViewDefinition Environment Variables: %rowIndex type is integer; Type Hinting default mapping maps integer to INT.
issues.evidence: Fresh SOF-VD-11 HISTORIAN probe passed official spec_tests under native and forced fallback, then failed focused Patient.address View Runner type check: column path %rowIndex declared type integer returned DuckDB typeof(address_index)=BIGINT instead of INTEGER. Generated SQL bypassed SQLGenerator._TYPE_CAST because generate_column_expr returned COALESCE(alias__row_index, 0) directly for resolved_path == %rowIndex.
issues.root_cause: SQLGenerator.generate_column_expr() had a direct %rowIndex fast path that returned the DuckDB UNNEST ordinal expression unchanged, bypassing the existing declared integer SQL cast used by ordinary ViewDefinition columns.
issues.resolution: Cast direct %rowIndex column expressions through SQLGenerator._get_sql_cast(column.type), so type: integer emits TRY_CAST(... AS INTEGER) under native C++ and forced Python fallback execution. Added an integration regression asserting typeof(name_index)=INTEGER for a declared integer %rowIndex column in both backends.
